item.title: [DEVELOPING] Inflation & Employment in the Age of Supply Shocks and AI — US job market faces challenges despite economic growth
item.description: The US economy is experiencing growth, yet hiring rates and job openings are declining. Concerns are rising that a challenging job market may persist.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Europe's Economic Growth Strategies — Christine Lagarde discusses Europe's growth model in WSJ interview
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank, discussed Europe's economic strategies in an interview with the Wall Street Journal. The conversation touched on the continent's efforts to leverage its size for economic scale, focusing on digital and green transitions to enhance competitiveness and productivity. The interview highlights the ECB's commitment to integrating these transitions as part of a broader growth model.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Europe's Economic Growth Strategies — ECB's Lagarde outlines Europe's new growth model
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank, has articulated a new growth model for Europe, focusing on turning the continent's size into scale. The approach emphasizes leveraging Europe's collective economic strength to enhance competitiveness and productivity. Lagarde's speech highlights the strategic importance of integrating digital and green transitions to drive sustainable growth.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — NY Fed's Williams: Tariff burden impacts US inflation goals
item.description: New York Fed President John Williams stated that the burden of tariffs falls 'overwhelmingly' on U.S. businesses and consumers. He noted that these tariffs are hindering the Federal Reserve's ability to achieve its 2% inflation target.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] China's Economic Growth & Policy Shifts — China to announce economic targets and policies for the year ahead
item.description: Chinese Premier Li Qiang is scheduled to announce economic targets and policies for the upcoming year on Thursday.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran-Gulf Military Conflict — Stock markets and oil prices remain volatile amid Iran conflict concerns
item.description: Stock markets and oil prices continue to exhibit volatility due to ongoing concerns about the Iran-Gulf conflict. Experts have warned that if oil and gas prices remains elevated it could make goods and services more expensive.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — US trade court orders tariff refunds, impacting Trump administration
item.description: A trade court has authorized refunds for tariffs that were invalidated by the Supreme Court last month. This decision represents a setback for the Trump administration's trade policy efforts. The ruling allows businesses to reclaim funds paid under the now-invalid tariffs.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] China's Economic Growth & Policy Shifts — China to increase defense spending by 7%, slowest growth since 2021
item.description: China plans to increase its defense budget by 7%, marking the slowest pace of growth since 2021. This decision comes amid ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and persistent tensions over Taiwan. The planned budget reflects a cautious approach in military spending despite regional geopolitical tensions.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] China's Economic Growth & Policy Shifts — China Sets Lowest Economic Growth Target Since 1991
item.description: China has set its lowest economic growth target since 1991. This marks the first time the target has been lowered since it was adjusted to 'around 5%' in 2023.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran-Gulf Military Conflict — UK firms reduce fixed energy deals amid Iran conflict price surge
item.description: UK firms have significantly reduced the number of fixed-term energy deals as wholesale energy prices surge. The data indicates that the availability of these deals has more than halved.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — States sue Trump administration over new tariffs deemed unlawful
item.description: Twenty-four states have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration, seeking to block the latest tariffs imposed to replace those invalidated by the Supreme Court. The states argue that these new tariffs are unlawful. This legal action adds to the ongoing challenges against the administration's trade policies.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Europe's Tokenised Finance Development — Agencies clarify capital treatment of tokenized securities
item.description: Agencies have clarified the capital treatment of tokenized securities. This development affects sectors including equities, commodities, and currencies. The clarification aims to provide guidance on how these digital assets should be treated within the financial system.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Sanctions & Russian Oil Sales — US Grants India 30-Day Waiver for Russian Oil Amid Iran Conflict
item.description: The US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has granted India a 30-day waiver to purchase Russian crude oil. This decision is described as a 'stop gap measure' in response to the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Consumer Spending & Oil Price Impact — Heating oil costs rise amid Middle East conflict, affecting rural areas
item.description: The price of heating oil has increased due to the ongoing Middle East conflict, impacting rural residents significantly. This development adds to the existing pressure on commodities and currencies as oil prices remain elevated.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Inflation & Employment in the Age of Supply Shocks and AI — US economy unexpectedly sheds 92,000 jobs in February
item.description: The US economy lost 92,000 jobs in February, contrary to expectations. The decline in payrolls affected nearly every sector, indicating a broad-based contraction.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Inflation & Employment in the Age of Supply Shocks and AI — Isabel Schnabel discusses inflation and employment amid supply shocks and AI
item.description: Isabel Schnabel, a member of the European Central Bank's Executive Board, addressed the challenges of managing inflation and employment in the context of ongoing supply shocks and the rise of artificial intelligence. Schnabel highlighted the complexities these factors introduce to monetary policy, emphasizing the need for adaptive strategies. The discussion reflects concerns over the impact of technological advancements and global disruptions on economic stability.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Consumer Spending & Oil Price Impact — Potential knock-on effects on fuel and food costs if oil prices remain high
item.description: The source indicates that sustained high oil prices could lead to increased costs for petrol and diesel, as well as food.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Asia's Role in the International Monetary System — Asia's Growing Influence in the International Monetary System
item.description: Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour, Governor of the Central Bank of Malaysia, highlighted Asia's increasing role in the international monetary system during his opening remarks at the SEACEN Policy Summit. He emphasized the region's economic growth and integration as key factors contributing to this shift. Ghaffour noted the importance of regional cooperation and policy coordination in enhancing Asia's influence. The remarks were made in Kuala Lumpur on February 5, 2026.
